name: Naginata
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, Ultimate Combat pg. 133
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, Ultimate Combat pg. 133
Statistics
Cost 35 gp Weight 9 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x4; Range —; Type S; Special reach
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Polearms
Description
The naginata consists of a 6-foot staff affixed to a 2-foot-long, slightly curved, swordlike blade. The shaft is designed to keep the wielder out of reach from swords and shorter weapons.
